title: centromere-chip-enrichment: ChIP-seq enrichment analysis at centromeric repeats
description: ChIP-seq analysis pipeline for centromeric and repetitive regions: from raw FASTQs to per-chromosome enrichment scores at alpha-satellite higher-order repeats (HORs), human satellites and chromosome arms. Keeps multi-mapping reads, supports single-end and paired-end data, optional exogenous spike-in normalisation, and produces base-weighted enrichment scores with lollipop plots.
